desc: Ideation: select bounded-cost characterization (answer is -1 or cost 1/2/3; for M>=3 a cost-3 construction exists when no cost 1/2 exists).
Implement initial O(M log M) solution (current code).
Fix sample 1 mismatch by reordering cost-2 checks and changing sort/tie-breaking as in NEXT (containment before type-1 cover; L asc, R asc; same-L containment detection).
Test on the four samples and small brute-force/random cases (N<=5, M<=4) comparing minimum cost and validating the printed operations.
Check edge cases: N=1, full intervals, duplicate intervals, adjacent intervals, boundary intervals, M=1/2, and large M output performance.
